sloka: सम्पातिस्तु त्रिभिर्बाणैः प्रजङ्घेन समाहतः ।निजघानाश्वकर्णेन प्रजङ्घं रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.४३.२० ।।।।
transliteration: sampātistu tribhirbāṇaiḥ prajaṅghena samāhataḥ ।nijaghānāśvakarṇena prajaṅghaṁ raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.43.20 ।।।।

translations.english: While Prajangha injured Sampathi with three arrows, in turn Sampathi killed him with Aswakarna tree in the midst of war.
